`js-yaml.mjs` and `js-yaml.LICENSE` are unmodified files from `js-yaml@4.1.1`
(https://github.com/nodeca/js-yaml/releases/tag/4.1.1), licensed MIT.
The npm tarball SHA-512 integrity is
`sha512-qQKT4zQxXl8lLwBtHMWwaTcGfFOZviOJet3Oy/xmGk2gZH677CJM9EvtfdSkgWcATZhj/55JZ0rmy3myCT5lsA==`.
Bundling the standalone module keeps installed/development snapshots independent
of the host's dependencies. YAML is parsed with JSON_SCHEMA; no executable tags.
